full_judgment: 2. The petitioners herein sought to review the order passed in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No 524 of 2002 wherein it was stated, inter alia, that the petitioners are citizens of Bangladesh and are members of the Arifabad Co-operative Housing Society and are plot owners in the Arifabad. Housing Society by purchase. The Arifabad Co-operative Housing Society Limited hereinafter referred to as the Society purchased 11.85 acres of land by a registered deed of sale dated 15.12.1980 from the lawful owners namely (1) Mr. Roshan Ali Hijri, (2) Mr. Nasiruddin Hijri, (3) Mr. Boustan Hijri and (4) Ms. Najli Hasan, legal heirs of Mrs. Gulshan Roshan Ali Hijri who died in Dhaka on 17.02.1957; and that they belong to the Shia Imami Islmaili Community and that they are all Bangladeshi as has been confirmed by the Ministry of Home Affairs and that Mr. Roshan Ali Hijri, husband of afore-said Mrs. Gulshan Roshap Ali Hijri is alive and carrying on his business as Managing Director of Dhaka Refractor Limited, a company Limited by shares. The Society after purchase of the property as aforesaid got its name mutated with the Revenue Office at Tejgaon and that after developing the said land by earth filling created 1401 residential plots and made internal Roads therein and got water, gas and electricity connections and thereafter sold the plots to individual persons of which the petitioners have constructed their respective houses with approved plan from RAJUK and taking loans from Banks obtaining non-encumbrance certificates issued from the Revenue office and that as per survey held in 1999, the newly created 140 plots were given new and separate plot numbers, which are recorded in the individual names of the plot interested person, the settlement officer of Dhaka initiated Miscellaneous Case No. 2103 of 1995 of 16.02.1995 and required the Assistant Settlement Officer, Dhaka to investigate after serving proper notice to the concerned person and to submit his report to him but it appears that without serving any notice on the plot owners of the society including the petitioners, although they are in possession by constructing their respective pucca buildings submitted his report dated 25.04.1995 stating that the owners of the plots were not available at their given addresses. It is stated here that in the printed S.A. khatian the name of Mrs. Gulshan Roshan Ali Hijri Still exists an owner in spite of the fact that the Society got its name mutated in the year 1984 in the record of rights with the office of Circle Officer, Tejgaon and paid rents to Mirpur Tashil Office and accordingly the said Assistant Settlement Officer issued notice upon the recorded owner Mrs. Gulshan Hijri at an old address where nobody lives in as much as she died in 1957 and for reasons best known to the Assistant Settlement officer, he did not serve any notice on the occupants of the plots in question who are living there constructing their respective residential houses and huts. The said Assistant settlement Officer, Dhaka recommended for treating the said property as an abandoned property which the Settlement Officer, Dhaka on 08.01.1997 in Miscellaneous Case No. 2103 of 1995 approved treating the properties as abandoned property on the basis of the report of the Assistant Settlement Officer prior to passing the order, but did not give any opportunity of hearing to the owner occupiers and that it appears that the Settlement Officer also did not consult the concern Revenue Office i.e. officer of the Circle Office, Tejgaon, and being aggrieved the petitioners made representation to the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka on 24.01.1998 and/or 31.10.1999 but without any result and the property in reference has not been declared abandoned properties under President Order No. 16 of 1972 and also not published in the list of abandoned properties in the Gazette Notification under Ordinance No .54 of 1985; no notice has been served upon the occupiers till date for delivery of possession of the lands in reference declaring the same as abandoned property. It appears that on the basis of the order dated 08.01.1997 passed on an application filed by one Mrs. Shirin Begum and 50 others, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Land), Tejgaon Circle to consider their application for Settlement of the lands in reference and said Assistant Commissioner (Land) has submitted a collusive report on 09.12.1997 but in the report it has been admitted that the petitioners are in possession of the lands, and it now appears that aforesaid Shirin Begum and other are instrumental in the initiation of Miscellaneous Case No. 2103 of 1995 and that having failed to get redress as aforesaid; the petitioners caused service of legal notice on the respondents on 15.11.1999 through their lawyers. The management of the Society as vendors of the petitioners has also obtained a Rule in writ petition No. 3400 of 1998 on 03.11.1998 challenging the impugned decision and on which an order of stay has been granted.
